title: Amidst the Glow
description: The northern lights shine behind an abandoned homestead near Crawford, Nebraska. The light display can sometimes be seen in the Nebraska Panhandle, but only during strong geomagnetic storms, which happen just a few times a year. Also known as aurora borealis, the northern lights result from the collision of the sun's ions with gas atoms in Earth's atmosphere, which then releases particles of light in different colors.
translated_description: 内布拉斯加州克劳福德附近，北极光在一座废弃农舍后闪耀。这种光芒有时能在内布拉斯加州狭长地带看到，但仅在强地磁暴期间出现，而这类地磁暴每年仅发生几次。北极光又称“北极光”，源于太阳离子与地球大气层中气体原子的碰撞，随后释放出不同颜色的光粒子。
